_note: DRAFT sessions written from general football-training knowledge. To be replaced/refined by the agent's position research (winger/striker/CM, 5-a-side and 7-a-side). Times in seconds.

sessions.title: Close control & 1v1
sessions.summary: Tight-space control, direction changes with the ball, 1v1 reactions with voice cues, finish.

blocks.name: Jog + dynamic leg swings
blocks.how: Easy jog, then leg swings front/side, walking lunges with a twist. Keep it relaxed.

blocks.name: Hip openers + glute activation
blocks.how: 90/90 hip switches, glute bridges, lateral band-free side steps. Hip and knee insurance.

blocks.name: Build-up sprints (no ball)
blocks.how: 10-15 m at 70%, 80%, 90%. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.

blocks.name: Juggling
blocks.how: Round 1 right foot, round 2 left foot, round 3 both feet + thighs. Count your best streak.

blocks.name: Sprint + change of direction (no ball)
blocks.how: Sprint 10 m to a marker, plant hard, cut 45-90 degrees, accelerate 5 m. Alternate the cutting foot.

blocks.name: Tight-space close control
blocks.how: Stay inside a 3x3 m square. Soles, inside/outside touches, quick turns. Head up.

blocks.name: Dribble + change direction
blocks.how: Drive the ball between markers: cut, drag-back, step-over. Explode out of every turn. Use your left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

blocks.name: Freestyle dribbling
blocks.how: Free play with the ball: feints, rolls, step-overs, whatever you want to own. Try one new move each round.

blocks.name: 1v1 reaction (voice cues)
blocks.how: Attack a marker as the defender. When you hear LEFT or RIGHT, the defender is committing that way: go the other way and accelerate past.

blocks.name: 1v1 then finish
blocks.how: Same cue game, but finish with a shot after you beat the marker. Alternate feet.

blocks.name: Cool-down: hips, quads, hamstrings, IT band
blocks.how: Hip flexor stretch, quad stretch, hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch, 60 s each side. Breathe slowly.

sessions.title: Wall passing, weak foot & shooting
sessions.summary: First touch off the wall (ground and air), left-foot work, shooting still and moving, crossing.

blocks.name: Jog + dynamic leg swings
blocks.how: Easy jog, leg swings, high knees, butt kicks, side shuffles.

blocks.name: Hip openers + glute activation
blocks.how: 90/90 hip switches, glute bridges, clamshells.

blocks.name: Sprint + change of direction (no ball)
blocks.how: Sprint 10 m, plant, cut, accelerate 5 m. Alternate the cutting foot. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.

blocks.name: Wall passes: ground, both feet
blocks.how: 2-3 m from the wall. Round 1 right, 2 left, 3 alternate, 4 one-touch alternate. Pass firm, control with the first touch.

blocks.name: Wall passes: in the air
blocks.how: Throw or volley the ball at the wall and control the rebound out of the air: thigh, instep, chest. Left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

blocks.name: Weak foot (left): receive and pass
blocks.how: Pass off the wall with your left only, receive with your left only. Slow and accurate beats fast and sloppy.

blocks.name: Shooting: stationary
blocks.how: Set the ball, strike low and across the keeper. Alternate right and left. Plant foot next to the ball, head over it.

blocks.name: Shooting: on the move
blocks.how: Dribble 5-8 m, take one touch to set, shoot. Left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

blocks.name: Crossing and passing
blocks.how: Run along the wing, cross or pass to a target. Alternate lofted and driven. Both feet.

blocks.name: Cool-down: hips, quads, hamstrings, IT band
blocks.how: Hip flexor, quad, hamstring, figure-4 glute stretch, 60 s each side.

sessions.title: With a partner: one- and two-touch
sessions.summary: One- and two-touch passing on the ground and in the air, then 1v1s.

blocks.name: Jog + dynamic leg swings
blocks.how: Easy jog together, leg swings, lunges with a twist.

blocks.name: Ground passing: one touch
blocks.how: 5-8 m apart, firm pass on the ground. Round 1 right foot, 2 left foot, 3 alternate, 4 move side to side.

blocks.name: Ground passing: two touch
blocks.how: First touch sets the ball to the side, second touch passes. Open up your body to the pass.

blocks.name: Air control: one touch back
blocks.how: Partner tosses or lofts the ball. Control or volley it straight back. Thigh, instep, chest. Alternate feet.

blocks.name: Passing while moving
blocks.how: Pass and move along a line, one touch. Keep the pace up, call for the ball.

blocks.name: 1v1 with partner
blocks.how: Real defender. Attacker tries to beat him and finish or cross. Swap roles each round.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.how: Hip flexor, quad, hamstring, glute stretch, 45 s each side.

sessions.title: Recovery: hips, quads, hamstrings
sessions.summary: No ball. Loosen the hips and strengthen around the IT band.

blocks.name: Foam roll quads and glutes
blocks.how: Slow passes, pause on tight spots for 20-30 s. Roll the outer thigh lightly, not hard on the IT band.

blocks.name: 90/90 hip switches
blocks.how: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side with control.

blocks.name: Couch stretch (hip flexor/quad)
blocks.how: Rear knee on a mat, foot up on the wall or bench. Squeeze the glute. Each side.

blocks.name: Hamstring stretch
blocks.how: Lying leg raise with a strap or towel. Each side.

blocks.name: Glute bridge
blocks.how: Drive through the heels, pause 2 s at the top.

blocks.name: Side-lying leg raise / clamshell
blocks.how: Slow and controlled. Each side. Feel the outer hip, not the lower back.

blocks.name: Figure-4 glute stretch
blocks.how: Lying down, ankle over opposite knee. Each side.
